archetype: Luxury & Swiss Data Clarity (Warm Ivory, Deep Emerald, & Gold)
description: A premium, production-ready ERP/dashboard for an Indian Gold & Silver Jewellery Shop. The design balances the luxurious, high-end feel of a jewellery brand with the strict data clarity required for billing, inventory, and rate management.

fonts.usage: Brand logo, Login screen headings, Dashboard main titles, Invoice headers.
All UI elements, data tables, billing calculator, sidebar navigation, form inputs.

guidelines: NEVER use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Use tracking-tight for large headings and tracking-[0.2em] uppercase for small overlines/labels.
Ensure strong typographic hierarchy. H1 max text-4xl or text-5xl on desktop.
Use Deep Emerald (#06271F) as the brand anchor. It conveys wealth and stability.
Use Gold (#D4AF37) exclusively for key highlights, live rates, and primary actions.
Never use pure black or pure white. Tint backgrounds slightly for warmth.
Ensure APCA/WCAG contrast for all text, especially gold text on light backgrounds (use darker gold or background contrast).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' (1px crisp borders) for dense data tables and 'Flat Solid' with subtle 4px radius for dashboard cards. Avoid muddy glassmorphism on data-heavy billing screens.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadows. Rely on 1px borders to separate elements.
visual_enhancers.motion: Fast, subtle micro-interactions (0.15s ease). Hover states on rows must be distinct (e.g., bg-stone-100).

layouts.dashboard: Fixed left sidebar (collapsible on mobile), top header for global search & live gold/silver rates, fluid main content area.
layouts.grid: Bento-style or high-density grids for KPIs (e.g., Today's Sales, Live Rates). 12-column system for complex forms like the Billing Calculator.
layouts.spacing: Dense but breathable. p-4 or p-6 for cards. Forms should have gap-4.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI for Tabs, Tables, Dialogs, Select, Input, Form, and Sonner.
Customize Shadcn components to use Manrope and the Emerald/Gold color palette.
Avoid excessive rounded corners; use rounded-md or rounded-sm for a sharp, precise look suitable for finance/billing.
Billing Calculator must be highly usable with clear breakdown of Weight, Purity, Wastage, Making Charges, and GST.

login_background.description: Luxurious gold necklace set, ideal for the login screen background overlay.

invoice_logo_placeholder.description: Heavy Indian gold jewellery piece, can be used abstractly for branding.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or headers.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items).
Implement Recharts for sales graphs on the dashboard.
Include both Light and Dark mode toggle, defaulting to Light mode for high visibility in retail environments.
Ensure the printable invoice (A4/A5) strips away UI elements (sidebar/header) using print-specific CSS classes (@media print).
Do not center-align the entire app container.
Never use placeholder URLs; rely on the provided image URLs or CSS styling.
